logic_errors.title: Faulting explicit Quit never requests process exit and leaves both command owners permanently closed
logic_errors.detail: Both Quit branches call Shutdown before Application.Quit, without a guaranteed exit-attempt path. Corrected Shutdown deliberately surfaces AggregateException after attempting all cleanup. Any such exception prevents the non-editor Application.Quit call. Both owners are already closed; subsequent ordinary Quit commands return at their closed guards, and presentation command subscriptions have detached. This residual failure was not covered by the targeted normal-Quit group.
logic_errors.classification: Residual fault-path defect in this corrected snapshot; not claimed to be newly introduced by the two-file delta.
logic_errors.observed: Normal game and host player-mode controls each call the labelled Application.Quit double once. Faulting game and host Quit each call it zero times; physical/session/container are attempted once in order, media providers detach and library disposal is attempted once; all five actually thrown failures surface. A second ordinary Quit still calls Application.Quit zero times.
logic_errors.required_change: Guarantee a non-editor exit attempt after all shutdown attempts for both explicit Quit entrypoints, without masking collected cleanup failures. Retain normal shutdown idempotence, release order, exact-once media cleanup, and reentrancy safety. Add player-mode faulting Quit assertions to the targeted suite.
logic_errors.boundary: Exact staged production compiled unchanged; Application.Quit is only a counted managed double, not a native application/process-exit execution.

suggestions.detail: Completed actual Core/UI assembly, registry semantics, strict native serialization, real durability/archive/path admission, media playback/resource ownership, scene/probe ordering, native/player and original-suite gates remain parent-owned. The authorized future read-only QuantityText getter is not reported as a speculative dependency defect.
